mapper.sql: s.id as step_id, t.id as task_id, t.account_id, t.avatar_version_id, t.source_file_id, f.object_key as source_object_key, s.action_code, s.attempt_no, s.lease_epoch, json_unquote(json_extract(t.service_snapshot, '$.modelId')) as model_id, json_unquote(json_extract(t.service_snapshot, '$.parameters')) as parameters, t.official_service_id, cast(json_unquote(json_extract(t.service_snapshot, '$.revision')) as unsigned) as service_revision, s.status as step_status, a.id as existing_attempt_id, s.reserved_attempt_id, a.provider_request_key, json_extract(s.result_metadata, '$.providerReceipt') as receipt_json
mapper.select: select from p_generation_step s join p_generation_task t on t.id = s.task_id and t.account_id = s.account_id join p_file f on f.id = t.source_file_id and f.account_id = t.account_id and f.status = 'AVAILABLE' left join p_generation_attempt a on a.step_id = s.id and a.attempt_no = s.attempt_no where s.account_id = #{accountId} and s.task_id = #{taskId} and (s.status = 'READY' or (s.status = 'POLLING' and (s.next_run_at is null or s.next_run_at <= utc_timestamp(3))) or (s.status = 'RUNNING' and s.lease_expires_at <= utc_timestamp(3))) and s.step_type = 'GENERATE_ACTION' and t.status in ('QUEUED', 'PROCESSING') and exists (select 1 from p_official_service svc join p_secret secret on secret.id = svc.secret_id where svc.id = t.official_service_id and svc.status = 'ACTIVE' and svc.capability = 'AVATAR_GENERATION' and secret.status = 'ACTIVE') order by s.id limit 1 for update skip locked

select from p_generation_step s join p_generation_task t on t.id = s.task_id and t.account_id = s.account_id join p_file f on f.id = t.source_file_id and f.account_id = t.account_id and f.status = 'AVAILABLE' left join p_generation_attempt a on a.step_id = s.id and a.attempt_no = s.attempt_no where s.account_id = #{accountId} and s.task_id = #{taskId} and s.id = #{stepId} and s.lease_owner = #{workerId} and s.lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch} and s.lease_expires_at > utc_timestamp(3) for update
mapper.update: update p_generation_step set attempt_no = case when status = 'READY' then attempt_no + 1 else attempt_no end, stage_started_at = case when status = 'RUNNING' then stage_started_at else utc_timestamp(3) end, status = 'RUNNING', lease_epoch = lease_epoch + 1, lease_owner = #{workerId}, lease_expires_at = date_add(utc_timestamp(3), interval 5 minute), heartbeat_at = utc_timestamp(3), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where id = #{stepId} and lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch} and (status in ('READY','POLLING') or (status = 'RUNNING' and lease_expires_at <= utc_timestamp(3)))

update p_generation_task set status = 'PROCESSING', internal_state = 'RUNNING', started_at = coalesce(started_at, utc_timestamp(3)), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where account_id = #{accountId} and id = #{taskId} and status = 'QUEUED'
mapper.insert: insert into p_generation_attempt (id, created_at, updated_at, account_id, task_id, step_id, attempt_no, lease_epoch, provider_request_key, model_id, status, request_hash) values (#{id}, utc_timestamp(3), utc_timestamp(3), #{claim.accountId}, #{claim.taskId}, #{claim.stepId}, #{claim.attemptNo}, #{claim.leaseEpoch}, #{providerRequestKey}, #{claim.modelId}, 'PREPARED', #{requestHash})

insert into p_avatar_action_selection (avatar_version_id, action_code, account_id, latest_attempt_id, updated_at) values (#{claim.avatarVersionId}, #{claim.actionCode}, #{claim.accountId}, #{attemptId}, utc_timestamp(3)) on duplicate key update latest_attempt_id = values(latest_attempt_id), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3)

insert into p_avatar_action_result (id, created_at, account_id, avatar_version_id, action_code, step_id, attempt_id, atlas_file_id, manifest_file_id, frame_count, fps, loop_enabled, frame_layout, qa_report, content_hash) values (#{id}, utc_timestamp(3), #{claim.accountId}, #{claim.avatarVersionId}, #{claim.actionCode}, #{claim.stepId}, #{attemptId}, #{atlasId}, #{manifestId}, json_extract(#{manifest}, '$.frameCount'), json_extract(#{manifest}, '$.fps'), case when json_extract(#{manifest}, '$.loop') = true then 1 else 0 end, cast(#{manifest} as json), json_object('geometryOk', json_extract(#{manifest}, '$.geometryOk'), 'warnings', json_extract(#{manifest}, '$.warnings'), 'visualAccepted', false), #{hash})
mapper.update: update p_generation_attempt set provider_task_id = coalesce(#{providerTaskId}, provider_task_id), provider_request_id = coalesce(#{providerRequestId}, provider_request_id), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where id = #{attemptId} and step_id = #{stepId} and lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch} and status in ('PREPARED','SUBMITTED') and (provider_task_id is null or #{providerTaskId} is null or provider_task_id = #{providerTaskId})

update p_generation_step set result_metadata = json_set(coalesce(result_metadata, json_object()), '$.providerReceipt', cast(#{receipt} as json)), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where id = #{stepId} and lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch} and lease_expires_at > utc_timestamp(3)

update p_generation_attempt set status = #{status}, provider_request_id = coalesce(#{providerRequestId}, provider_request_id), error_code = #{errorCode}, submitted_at = case when #{status} = 'SUBMITTED' then coalesce(submitted_at, utc_timestamp(3)) else submitted_at end, completed_at = case when #{status} in ('UNKNOWN','FAILED') then utc_timestamp(3) else completed_at end, updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where id = #{attemptId} and step_id = #{stepId} and attempt_no = #{attemptNo} and lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch} and (status in ('PREPARED', 'SUBMITTED') or status = #{status})

update p_generation_step set stage_started_at = case when status = #{status} then stage_started_at else utc_timestamp(3) end, status = #{status}, error_code = #{errorCode}, heartbeat_at = utc_timestamp(3), lease_expires_at = case when #{status} = 'POLLING' then utc_timestamp(3) else date_add(utc_timestamp(3), interval 5 minute) end, next_run_at = case when #{status} = 'POLLING' then date_add(utc_timestamp(3), interval 10 second) else next_run_at end, updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where account_id = #{accountId} and task_id = #{taskId} and id = #{stepId} and lease_owner = #{workerId} and lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch} and lease_expires_at > utc_timestamp(3)

update p_generation_step set stage_started_at = case when status = #{status} then stage_started_at else utc_timestamp(3) end, status = #{status}, lease_expires_at = null, heartbeat_at = utc_timestamp(3), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where account_id = #{accountId} and task_id = #{taskId} and id = #{stepId} and lease_owner = #{workerId} and lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch} and lease_expires_at > utc_timestamp(3)

update p_generation_step set status = 'READY', stage_started_at = utc_timestamp(3), error_code = #{errorCode}, lease_owner = null, lease_expires_at = null, heartbeat_at = utc_timestamp(3), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where account_id = #{accountId} and task_id = #{taskId} and id = #{stepId} and lease_owner = #{workerId} and lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch} and lease_expires_at > utc_timestamp(3) and status = 'RUNNING' and not exists (select 1 from p_generation_attempt a where a.step_id = p_generation_step.id and a.attempt_no = p_generation_step.attempt_no and a.lease_epoch = p_generation_step.lease_epoch)

update p_generation_step s set status = 'READY', stage_started_at = utc_timestamp(3), error_code = #{errorCode}, lease_owner = null, lease_expires_at = null, heartbeat_at = utc_timestamp(3), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where s.account_id = #{accountId} and s.task_id = #{taskId} and s.status = 'RUNNING' and s.lease_expires_at <= utc_timestamp(3) and not exists (select 1 from p_generation_attempt a where a.step_id = s.id and a.attempt_no = s.attempt_no and a.lease_epoch = s.lease_epoch)

update p_generation_task t set t.progress = (select floor(100 * sum(case when s.status in ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','UNKNOWN') then 1 else 0 end) / count(*)) from p_generation_step s where s.account_id = #{accountId} and s.task_id = #{taskId}), t.updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where t.account_id = #{accountId} and t.id = #{taskId} and t.status in ('QUEUED','PROCESSING')

update p_generation_task set status = 'SUCCEEDED', internal_state = 'REVIEW_REQUIRED', progress = 100, finished_at = utc_timestamp(3), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where account_id = #{accountId} and id = #{taskId} and status in ('QUEUED','PROCESSING') and not exists (select 1 from p_generation_step s where s.account_id = #{accountId} and s.task_id = #{taskId} and s.status != 'SUCCEEDED')
mapper.select: select count(*) from p_generation_step s join p_generation_task t on t.id = s.task_id and t.account_id = s.account_id where s.account_id = #{accountId} and s.task_id = #{taskId} and t.status in ('QUEUED','PROCESSING') and s.step_type = 'GENERATE_ACTION' and s.status in ('READY','RUNNING','POLLING')
mapper.update: update p_generation_step set status = 'SUCCEEDED', stage_started_at = utc_timestamp(3), result_file_id = #{fileId}, result_metadata = json_merge_patch(coalesce(result_metadata, json_object()), cast(#{metadata} as json)), lease_expires_at = null, heartbeat_at = utc_timestamp(3), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where account_id = #{accountId} and task_id = #{taskId} and id = #{stepId} and lease_owner = #{workerId} and lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch} and lease_expires_at > utc_timestamp(3)

update p_generation_attempt set status = 'SUCCEEDED', output_file_id = #{fileId}, completed_at = utc_timestamp(3), updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where id = #{attemptId} and step_id = #{stepId} and attempt_no = #{attemptNo} and lease_epoch = #{leaseEpoch}
